lanternhold: Fortified library on an Ethiopian-highland-inspired coastal cliff. Massive pale stone arches, woven geometric borders, lamplit reading room and stacked scroll cases, open arch overlooking the sea at night.
griffon: Bare wind-bent trees arching over an empty dirt road, ditch on one side, distant approaching orange torches beneath a clouded full moon. Threatening night.
shore: Southern frontier coastal road through sand dunes and wind-bent scrub, ocean glittering beyond grass and old fenceposts. Clear adventurous late morning.
open_hand: Warm frontier walled coaching inn at blue dusk, heavy oak door reached by broad steps, amber lanterns, green Warden banner, horses stable visible. Welcoming but fortified.
thornbury: Southern frontier timber trading town, covered porches, low-beamed smoky inn open at the roadside, canvas merchant stalls and wet cobbles. No modern objects.
ford: Shallow brown river ford in a steep green valley, sharpened stakes and a gnoll hillfort visible up the opposite bank, ropes and bone warning charms. Windy afternoon.
dunmere: Poor Welsh-valley-inspired mining town under slate hills, stone cottages, garrison, simple protective temple, muddy central square and deep stone well, wool awnings.
dunmere_mine: Descending timber-shored iron mine, split shafts with wooden braces, mine carts, ore seams, puddles, lanterns and a flooded lower tunnel. Ominous but readable.
holloway: Steep lush green valley road, Nigerian-inspired Burning Gauntlet patrol camp, flame-red flags, disciplined canvas tents and wooden watchpost beneath high hills.
bandit_camp: Hidden rough palisade deep in the Gnashing Wood, muddy rutted yard, haphazard tents, large dark command tent with empty chains and iron shackles. No people.
mirkhollow: Ancient enormous gnarled forest, white webs between roots, standing stones with ochre markings and red-black checked cloth offerings, shafts of green light, high crags behind.
iron_mine: Oppressive Consortium industrial mine gate, iron bars and empty cages, ledger checkpoint, wet dark stone, pulley ropes, gold-black merchant seals, torch-lit.
span: Grand fortified bridge over a wide luminous river, Nigerian-inspired fantasy metropolis beyond with monumental terracotta and stone buildings, woven awnings, coral-red and gold flags.
sewers: Dwarven-carved foundations below Nigerian fantasy city docks, broad brick vaults and geometric stonework, flowing black-green water, dry stone walkway, amber lamps and outlet light.
nine_lanterns: Rich Nigerian-inspired merchant house with exactly NINE distinct hanging amber lanterns across its front above the carved door, geometric facade, counting desks visible inside. Night.
palace: Nigerian-inspired grand ducal hall, high carved stone pillars, aso-oke-inspired geometric banners of four houses, four distinct banners behind broad dais, ceremonial throne, polished amber stone.
tower: Six-floor Nigerian-inspired merchant tower interior, grand marble counting hall, brass ledger cages, rich woven silk hangings, upper galleries, geometric carved wood, cool gold-black luxury.
catacombs: Ancient pale coastal limestone catacombs, solemn carved faces on tomb niches, a narrow low passage toward blue shore light, dust in amber lamp beams. Quiet dread.
hunted_city: Nigerian-inspired city dockside at wet dusk, wanted posters as illegible sketch marks on rain-dark walls, fishing skiffs, indigo cloth awnings, narrow cellar-market entrance and hidden amber lanterns.
undercity: Buried older Nigerian-inspired city, collapsed carved stone streets under a cavern roof, monumental gate, broken geometric mosaic, temple stairway in the distance, cool ash and old gold light.
temple: Black-stone sanctum meticulously swept and lit, tall austere pillars, ritual lamps, throne-shaped altar above broad steps, ash on the floor, no people, heavy oppressive silence.
gnoll_fort: Interior of a crude hillfort made of sharpened stakes, enormous animal bones, hide banners, scavenged shields and rough watchtowers overlooking a brown river.
black_altar: Deepest iron mine chamber with a squat black altar, rust-red mineral veins, ritual bowls and poison-black runoff, torchlight under rotting timber braces.
grove: Ancient Kenyan-inspired fantasy forest grove ringed by tall standing stones, red-black checked offerings, tiny colored beads, twisting roots and rich green canopy, no people.
cliffs: High jagged cliffs above ancient green forest, giant wyvern nest of branches and bone on broad rock ledge, blue sky and rolling distant mountains, wind-torn grasses.
valve: Enormous iron mine valve room, GREAT RUSTED HANDWHEEL on a central platform, heavy chains descending through gratings, black water rising below, amber industrial lanterns. Wheel clear on right half.
study: Meticulous underground mine mage office, leather-bound name ledgers in locked cases, magical ore testing table, narrow window onto barred cages, woven Nigerian-inspired collar motifs on wall seal.
sickroom: Quiet Nigerian ducal sick-room with empty canopied bed, indigo-and-coral woven coverlet, medicine table, carved geometric screens, early light, somber but not horror.
undervault: Hidden cellar-market beneath a Nigerian fantasy city, vaulted stone, crowded EMPTY stalls with unusual goods, indigo cloth, quiet lanterns, secret passage, ledgers and lockboxes.
mirrors: Deep black-stone temple hall lined with tall tarnished mirrors at unsettling angles, sparse ritual lamps and drifting ash. NO humans in reflections. Central aisle remains uncluttered.
counting: Rich Nigerian-inspired merchant counting chamber with ledger desks, brass balances, strongboxes, carved shutters, intricate geometric wall friezes and soft amber lanterns.
silk_floor: Private Nigerian-inspired tower apartment, burgundy silk hangings, carved ebony screens, coral jewelry on dressing table, low couches and balcony over city. Elegant controlled luxury.
